body.x: FA press conference @ ShowStoppers asks what comes next in consumer electronics and home appliances after January: Tuesday, 8 Jan. 2013, 5 pm, one hour before ShowStoppers begins.

At the Wynn, Lafleur 2, across the hall from the Lafite Ballroom, you may pick up your event badge as early as 4 pm. Doors open for the press conference at 5 pm.Bring a business card and photo ID to registration at the ballroom to exchange for your event badge -- or, print this confirmation message, bring it and a photo ID to ShowStoppers check in.
Also a new event, ShowStoppers LaunchIt, the official Eureka Park pitch event at CES: Monday, 7 Jan. 2013, 3:15-5:15 pm, will be held at South Seas Ballroom J, Mandalay Bay Hotel.

Produced by ShowStoppers in partnership with the New York Angels and the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA)®.Judged by Angel investors and venture capitalists.Presenters are selected from Eureka Park exhibitors.Bring a business card to registration for event entry.
